messages.content: Create a scene showing the creation of high beta plasmoids work. Visualize plasma physics with energetic beta plasmoid formations, magnetic field lines, and fusion dynamics in a 3D interactive scene.

I'll build this in Three.js using custom shaders to give the plasmoids that intense, pulsating toroidal glow you see in high beta confinement. I want to wrap the scene with animated magnetic field lines using Catmull-Rom curves and instanced particles to represent the chaotic fusion dynamics. Some post-processing bloom and color grading should help sell the fact that this plasma is incredibly hot and energetic.
I've outlined 7 steps. Kicking off code generation...

I'll tackle this in Three.js using a combination of instanced particle systems for the plasma and tubular curves for the magnetic topology, since the interplay between field lines and the plasmoid boundary is the whole story here. The visual hook needs to be intense volumetric glow, so I'll layer bloom and emissive materials to get that fusion-research aesthetic where the plasma feels dangerously energetic. For the plasmoids, I'm imagining warped torus knots that pulse and deform via vertex shaders to mimic high-beta instability and magnetic reconnection dynamics. I'll wire up OrbitControls so the user can navigate the containment geometry and watch field lines pinch and reconnect in real time.
